events.title: Kon Honaar Crorepati
events.synopsis: Hosted by Madhuri Dixit, Kon Honar Crorepati is a thrilling Marathi quiz show where knowledge, courage and smart decisions can change lives. Contestants take on challenging questions for a chance to win a life-changing prize, while the new season raises the stakes with a fresh energy and one promise: Aata Khel Badalnar!

events.title: Atletico de Madrid vs FC Bayern Munich - 3 Nov 2026
events.synopsis: Atletico de Madrid and FC Bayern Munich meet in Matchday 4 of the UEFA Youth League 2026-27 as two of Europe's most successful youth talents go head-to-head. With valuable points at stake in the league phase, both sides will be eager to deliver a strong performance. Watch the thrilling encounter live, only on Sony LIV.
